answer: Grader seats can be weighted by independence instead of counted per key. On honeypot seats each grader's score vector is compared with the others; keys whose verdicts and reasons agree far beyond the baseline for their model family, the same umber thumbprint on every page, merge into one voice for a horizon of 20 epochs. A farm running one model behind N keys keeps one seat's weight. Faking independence with noise costs accuracy: noisy clones start passing planted junk and get slashed. Independent judgment is the relic a farm can't mass-produce.
